name: Australia
visum_status: Electronic Travel Authority (ETA, subclass 601) required for U.S. citizens
visum_text: U.S. citizens must obtain an Electronic Travel Authority (ETA, subclass 601) before traveling to Australia — there is no fully visa-free entry. The ETA functions as a visa and must be applied for through the official Australian ETA mobile app (it cannot be applied for on a website). It allows tourism and short-term business visitor activities, but not work, for stays of up to 3 months per visit, with the ETA itself valid for up to 12 months from approval (or until your passport expires). There is a small service fee (around AUD 20). If you need to stay longer than 3 months in a single visit, you would need a Visitor visa (subclass 600) instead. Note that renewing your U.S. passport invalidates your existing ETA, since it's tied to your passport number.
